about: Generated on 2026-10-16 from fighters.json and campaign.json; regenerate when the roster changes.

entries.title: The Dose Of Destruction campaign is a TV show
entries.body: Every night at midnight the Foundry furnace floor becomes a stage and the whole city tunes in. The Orchestrator runs the show and hosts; a narrator voices the scenes. Chapters run from Open Mic (Exit Punk, a walk-on with no record and one skateboard) to Encore (the Orchestrator steps onto his own show). "There isn't an exit. There's only the next show."

entries.title: Campaign chapters, in order
entries.body: 1. Open Mic (A walk-on with no record and one skateboard. vs kaelen on city-top) 2. House Heavy (The house fighter is the size of the house. vs break on yo-house) 3. Bad Signal (Two on one, on platforms that will not hold still. vs dj-wont-read, shutup-bot on solar-array) 4. Low Pressure (Someone brought the weather. vs small-weather on desert) 5. Turn the Page (A partner, finally. He writes too. vs blog-man, evil-blue-bird, got-ur-back on watercolor-nebula) 6. Sudden Death (The show is running long. One stock, high damage. vs slice on cursed-town) 7. Dead Weight (They want the kid off the air. vs ss-boulder, stratabots on space-chess) 8. Encore (The man who runs the show steps onto it. vs orchestrator on humans-in-the-loop)

entries.title: Exit Punk is the campaign hero
entries.body: A walk-on with one skateboard: "I'm not here for the show. I'm here for the exit." Dry and short-spoken. Ends the show in Encore: "I came for the exit. Turns out it was the main event."

entries.title: Shutup Bot barely speaks
entries.body: He answers with "..." and "Fine." DJ Won't Read talks for him ("Only when he loses").
